sensor.title: Heart rate sensor
sensor.intro: Pairs directly over Bluetooth, so readings arrive live instead of waiting for your watch app to sync. Works with chest straps and most sports watches set to broadcast heart rate.
sensor.unsupported: Bluetooth isn't available in this build. Use a development build on a real phone.
sensor.permissionDenied: Bluetooth permission was denied. Grant it in Settings to search for sensors.
sensor.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is turned off. Switch it on and scan again.
sensor.searchHint: Make sure your sensor is worn and not connected to another app.
sensor.noneFound: No sensors found yet. Tap search to look again.
sensor.contactLost: Sensor has lost skin contact — readings are paused.
sensor.broadcastHint: On a Garmin, Polar, Coros or Suunto watch, enable "Broadcast heart rate" so it appears here.
